## Calculate Outliers

### Region-Specific Outlier Proportions

```{r}
#| label: outlier-rate-permutation-null
#| output: false
thresh = 0.025
n_perm <- 1000

outlier_df <- df %>% select(dx, Source, contains("Transformed.q.wre")) %>%
          pivot_longer(contains("Transformed.q.wre"), names_to = "feature",
                       values_to = "centile") %>%
          filter(feature %in% glue("{features}Transformed.q.wre")) %>%
          mutate(type = case_when(centile <= thresh ~ "low",
                                  centile >= (1 - thresh) ~ "high",
                                  .default = "normal")) %>%
          na.omit() %>%
          group_by(Source, feature, dx) %>%
          summarize(prop_low = sum(type == "low")/n(),
                    prop_high = sum(type == "high")/n(),
                    median = median(centile, na.rm = T),
                    var = var(centile, na.rm = T),
                    .groups = "drop_last") %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = dx, values_from = prop_low:var) %>% 
          arrange(Source, feature) %>%
          mutate(diff_low = prop_low_22q11DS - prop_low_CN,
                 diff_high = prop_high_22q11DS - prop_high_CN)

# Null distribution for the extreme-deviation rate: shuffle dx labels within each
# cohort and recompute the case-control difference in extreme (low/high) proportions,
# to test whether the observed rate in 22q11DS exceeds what's expected by chance.
for (i in 1:n_perm) {
  for (source in c("CHOP","ENIGMA")) {
    df_perm <- df %>% filter(Source == source) %>% mutate(dx = sample(dx))
  
  outlier_perm_df <- df_perm %>% select(dx, Source, contains("Transformed.q.wre")) %>%
          pivot_longer(contains("Transformed.q.wre"), names_to = "feature",
                       values_to = "centile") %>%
          filter(feature %in% glue("{features}Transformed.q.wre")) %>%
          mutate(type = case_when(centile <= thresh ~ "low",
                                  centile >= (1 - thresh) ~ "high",
                                  .default = "normal")) %>%
          na.omit() %>%
          group_by(Source, feature, dx) %>%
          summarize(prop_low = sum(type == "low")/n(),
                    prop_high = sum(type == "high")/n(),
                    median = median(centile, na.rm = T),
                    var = var(centile, na.rm = T),
                    .groups = "drop_last") %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = dx, values_from = prop_low:var) %>% 
          arrange(Source, feature) %>%
          mutate(diff_low = prop_low_22q11DS - prop_low_CN,
                 diff_high = prop_high_22q11DS - prop_high_CN,
                 perm = i)
  
    if(i == 1 & source == "CHOP") {
      outlier_perms <- outlier_perm_df
    } else {
      outlier_perms <- bind_rows(outlier_perms, outlier_perm_df)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: permutation-pvalues-and-fdr
#| output: false
# Permutation p-value: proportion of shuffled-label permutations whose case-control
# difference in extreme-deviation rate exceeds the observed difference.
outlier_df$p_low <- NA
outlier_df$p_high <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(outlier_df)) {
  perms_tmp <- outlier_perms %>% filter(Source == outlier_df$Source[i] &
                                        feature == outlier_df$feature[i])
  outlier_df$p_low[i] <- sum(perms_tmp$diff_low > outlier_df$diff_low[i])/n_perm
  outlier_df$p_high[i] <- sum(perms_tmp$diff_high > outlier_df$diff_high[i])/n_perm
}
outlier_df <- outlier_df %>%
                  pivot_wider(id_cols = feature, names_from = Source, 
                              values_from = prop_low_CN:p_high) %>%
                  mutate(p.fdr_low_ENIGMA  = p.adjust(p_low_ENIGMA, method = "fdr"),
                         p.fdr_high_ENIGMA = p.adjust(p_high_ENIGMA, method = "fdr"),
                         p.sig_low_ENIGMA  = ifelse(p.fdr_low_ENIGMA <= 0.05, "p.fdr < 0.05",
                                                    "n.s."),
                         p.sig_high_ENIGMA  = ifelse(p.fdr_high_ENIGMA <= 0.05, "p.fdr < 0.05",
                                                    "n.s."),
                         p.fdr_low_CHOP    = p.adjust(p_low_CHOP, method = "fdr"),
                         p.fdr_high_CHOP   = p.adjust(p_high_CHOP, method = "fdr"),
                         p.sig_low_CHOP  = ifelse(p.fdr_low_CHOP <= 0.05, "p.fdr < 0.05",
                                                    "n.s."),
                         p.sig_high_CHOP  = ifelse(p.fdr_high_CHOP <= 0.05, "p.fdr < 0.05",
                                                    "n.s."),
                         feature = str_remove_all(feature,"Transformed.q.wre"),
                         label = feature)
```

### Permutation Test

```{r}
#| label: chop-enigma-correlation-permutation-test
cats <- c("GM","SA","CT")

res <- expand_grid(measure = cats,
                   level = c("low","high"))
res$corr <- NA
res$pval <- NA

for (cat in cats) {
  
  # Calculate actual correlation
  res$corr[res$measure == cat & res$level == "low"] <- cor(outlier_df %>% filter(grepl(glue("{cat}\\."),feature)) %>% 
                                                             pull(prop_low_22q11DS_CHOP),
                                                            outlier_df %>% filter(grepl(glue("{cat}\\."),feature)) %>% 
                                                              pull(prop_low_22q11DS_ENIGMA),
                                                            method = "pearson")
  
  
  res$corr[res$measure == cat & res$level == "high"] <- cor(outlier_df %>% filter(grepl(glue("{cat}\\."),feature)) %>% 
                                                             pull(prop_high_22q11DS_CHOP),
                                                            outlier_df %>% filter(grepl(glue("{cat}\\."),feature)) %>% 
                                                              pull(prop_high_22q11DS_ENIGMA),
                                                            method = "pearson")
  
  # Calculate null correlations (high overlap)
  outlier_tmp <- outlier_perms %>% ungroup() %>% 
                    mutate(feature = str_remove_all(feature,"Transformed.q.wre")) %>%
                    filter(Source == "CHOP", grepl(glue("{cat}\\."),feature)) %>% 
                    select(feature, prop_high_22q11DS, perm) %>%
                    pivot_wider(names_from = perm, values_from = prop_high_22q11DS,
                                names_prefix = "prop_high_") %>%
                    left_join(outlier_df %>% select(feature, prop_high_22q11DS_ENIGMA)) %>%
                    select(-feature)

  corrs_tmp <- cor(outlier_tmp %>% select(-contains("ENIGMA")),
                   outlier_tmp %>% select(contains("ENIGMA")),
                                            method = "pearson")
  
  res$pval[res$measure == cat & res$level == "high"] <- sum(corrs_tmp >= res$corr[res$measure == cat & res$level == "high"])/n_perm
  
  # Calculate null correlations (low overlap)
  outlier_tmp <- outlier_perms %>% ungroup() %>% 
                    mutate(feature = str_remove_all(feature,"Transformed.q.wre")) %>%
                    filter(Source == "CHOP", grepl(glue("{cat}\\."),feature)) %>% 
                    select(feature, prop_low_22q11DS, perm) %>%
                    pivot_wider(names_from = perm, values_from = prop_low_22q11DS, names_prefix = "prop_high_") %>%
                    left_join(outlier_df %>% select(feature, prop_low_22q11DS_ENIGMA)) %>%
                    select(-feature)

  corrs_tmp <- cor(outlier_tmp %>% select(-contains("ENIGMA")),
                   outlier_tmp %>% select(contains("ENIGMA")),
                                            method = "pearson")
  
  res$pval[res$measure == cat & res$level == "low"] <- sum(corrs_tmp >= res$corr[res$measure == cat & res$level == "low"])/n_perm

  
}
print(res)
```

### Spin Test

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
#| label: cortical-spin-test
from util_scripts import parcellation_util
import pandas as pd
n_perm = 1000

prop_df = r.outlier_df
cats = ["GM","SA","CT"]
res = pd.DataFrame(columns=['corr', 'pval'], index=cats)
parcellation, dk_info = parcellation_util.define_parcellation()

for cat in cats:
  low_chop_tmp = prop_df.loc[prop_df.label.str.startswith(cat),
                      ["feature","label","prop_low_22q11DS_CHOP"]].copy()
  low_chop_tmp["prop_low"] = low_chop_tmp["prop_low_22q11DS_CHOP"]                    
  low_enigma_tmp = prop_df.loc[prop_df.label.str.startswith(cat),
                      ["feature","label","prop_low_22q11DS_ENIGMA"]].copy()
  low_enigma_tmp["prop_low"] = low_enigma_tmp["prop_low_22q11DS_ENIGMA"] 
  
  low_chop_tmp.loc[:,"hemi_label"]   = low_chop_tmp["label"].str.replace(f"{cat}.","")
  low_enigma_tmp.loc[:,"hemi_label"] = low_enigma_tmp["label"].str.replace(f"{cat}.","")

  # Spin test                  
  res.loc[cat,["corr","pval"]] = parcellation_util.spin_test(low_chop_tmp,
                                                       low_enigma_tmp, 
                                                      "prop_low", dk_info, parcellation)
  
```

```{python}
#| results: hold
#| label: print-spin-test-results
print("Cortical Spin Test of CHOP and ENIGMA Effect Sizes:")
print(res)
```

#### Generate Formatted Report Table

```{r}
#| label: build-formatted-outlier-tables
outlier_fmt <- outlier_df %>% 
                  ungroup() %>%
                  relocate(label, .before = feature) %>%
                  select(-feature, -starts_with("var_"), -starts_with("median_"), 
                         -starts_with("diff_"), -starts_with("p.sig_")) %>%
                  mutate(label = case_match(label,
                                            "Cerebellum.all" ~ "Cerebellum",
                                            "SUBC.Left_Accumbens.area" ~ "SUBC.Left_Accumbens",
                                            "SUBC.Right_Accumbens.area" ~ "SUBC.Right_Accumbens",
                                            .default = label)) %>%
                  separate_wider_delim(label, delim = ".", names = c("IDP Group", "IDP"),
                                       too_few = "align_end") %>%
                  mutate(`IDP Group` = ifelse(is.na(`IDP Group`), "Global", `IDP Group`),
                         `IDP Group` = factor(`IDP Group`, levels = c("Global","SUBC","GM","SA","CT")),
                         across(contains("prop"), ~ round(.x, 2)),
                         across(starts_with("p_"), ~ round(.x, 3)),
                         across(starts_with("p\\."), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
                  select(`IDP Group`, IDP,
                         prop_low_22q11DS_CHOP, prop_low_CN_CHOP, 
                         p_low_CHOP, p.fdr_low_CHOP,
                         prop_high_22q11DS_CHOP, prop_high_CN_CHOP, 
                         p_high_CHOP, p.fdr_high_CHOP,
                         prop_low_22q11DS_ENIGMA, prop_low_CN_ENIGMA, 
                         p_low_ENIGMA, p.fdr_low_ENIGMA,
                         prop_high_22q11DS_ENIGMA, prop_high_CN_ENIGMA, 
                         p_high_ENIGMA, p.fdr_high_ENIGMA) %>%
                  arrange(`IDP Group`, IDP)

outlier_fmt_chop <- outlier_fmt %>% select(`IDP Group`, IDP, contains("CHOP"))
outlier_fmt_enigma <- outlier_fmt %>% select(`IDP Group`, IDP, contains("ENIGMA"))

colnames(outlier_fmt_chop) <- colnames(outlier_fmt_chop) %>%
                            str_replace_all("22q11DS","22q11DS") %>%
                            str_replace_all("CN","CN") %>%
                            str_replace_all("prop_low_","") %>%
                            str_replace_all("prop_high_","") %>%
                            str_remove_all("_CHOP") %>%
                            str_remove_all("_low") %>%
                            str_remove_all("_high") %>%
                            str_replace_all("p.fdr","p (FDR)")


colnames(outlier_fmt_enigma) <- colnames(outlier_fmt_enigma) %>%
                            str_replace_all("22q11DS","22q11DS") %>%
                            str_replace_all("CN","CN") %>%
                            str_replace_all("prop_low_","") %>%
                            str_replace_all("prop_high_","") %>%
                            str_remove_all("_ENIGMA") %>%
                            str_remove_all("_low") %>%
                            str_remove_all("_high") %>%
                            str_replace_all("p.fdr","p (FDR)")

outlier_fmt_chop
write_csv(outlier_fmt_chop, "../tables/formatted/table_s07.csv")

outlier_fmt_enigma
write_csv(outlier_fmt_enigma, "../tables/formatted/table_s08.csv")
```

```{r, fig.width = 6.67, fig.height = 6}
#| label: chop-enigma-correlation-scatterplots
#| fig-cap: "Figure S8. Correlation between CHOP and ENIGMA regional extreme deviation rates in 22q11DS cases, for extreme low (top) and extreme high (bottom) deviations, by imaging metric."

plot_df <- outlier_df %>% 
            filter(grepl("GM\\.|SA\\.|CT\\.",label)) %>%
            separate_wider_delim(label,delim = ".", names = c("measure","label")) %>%
      left_join(corrs) %>%
      mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = c("GM","SA","CT"),
                              labels = c("Grey Matter Volume", "Surface Area", "Cortical Thickness")),
             corr_low = as.character(round(corr_low,2)),
             pval_low = as.character(round(pval_low,4)),
             corr_high = as.character(round(corr_high,2)),
             pval_high = as.character(round(pval_high,4)),
             label_text_low = paste0(
                              "r == ", corr_low,
                              "~','~p[perm] == ", pval_low),
             label_text_low = str_replace_all(label_text_low, "== 0$", "< 0.001"),
             label_text_low = ifelse(label == "lh_bankssts",label_text_low, ""),
             label_text_high = paste0(
                              "r == ", corr_high,
                              "~','~p[perm] == ", pval_high),
             label_text_high = str_replace_all(label_text_high, "== 0$", "< 0.001"),
             label_text_high = ifelse(label == "lh_bankssts",label_text_high, ""))

p1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = prop_low_22q11DS_CHOP, y = prop_low_22q11DS_ENIGMA)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
  facet_wrap(~ measure, nrow = 1) + coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  xlab("Prop Extreme Low (CHOP)") +
  ylab("Prop Extreme Low (ENIGMA)") +
  xlim(0,0.5) + ylim(0,0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_text_low, x=0.25, y=0.45), parse = T, size = 4)

p2 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = prop_high_22q11DS_CHOP, y = prop_high_22q11DS_ENIGMA)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + 
  facet_wrap(~ measure, nrow = 1) + coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  xlab("Prop Extreme High (CHOP)") +
  ylab("Prop Extreme High (ENIGMA)") +
  xlim(0,0.5) + ylim(0,0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_text_high, x=0.25, y=0.45), parse = T, size = 4)
  

ggarrange(p1, p2, nrow = 2)
ggsave("../figures_final/png/figure_s8_extreme_deviation_correlation.png", bg = "white")
ggsave("../figures_final/pdf/figure_s8_extreme_deviation_correlation.pdf", bg = "white")
```
